nodes.definition: Прочные механические комплексы, образующиеся при флокуляции микроорганизмов с ультрадисперсными частицами золота и серебра. Содержание благородных металлов в них в десятки и сотни раз превышает фоновое, что делает их пригодными для флотационного извлечения.
nodes.text: Biomineral Aggregates (биоминеральные агрегаты, биометаллические агрегаты, агрегаты микроорганизм-золото)

nodes.name: Irgiredmet (Irkutsk Research Institute of Precious and Rare Metals)
nodes.definition: Научно-исследовательский институт, разработавший принципиальную технологическую схему извлечения золота и меди на основе сернокислотного и тиокарбамидного выщелачивания, апробированную на флотоконцентрате Артемовской обогатительной фабрики.
nodes.text: Irgiredmet (Irkutsk Research Institute of Precious and Rare Metals) (Иргиредмет, Иркутский научно-исследовательский институт благородных и редких металлов)
aliases: Иркутский научно-исследовательский институт благородных и редких металлов

nodes.name: Flotation Cell Residence Time
nodes.definition: The time that pulp or particles remain in a flotation cell. It is a key process condition because it controls how long minerals can contact reagents and bubbles before leaving the machine.
nodes.text: Flotation Cell Residence Time (продолжительность пребывания пульпы, время пребывания в камере, время пребывания частиц в камере)

nodes.name: Barrett No. 4 Oil
nodes.definition: A proprietary petroleum-derived flotation oil used as a collector/frother in sulfide flotation. At the Giant Yellowknife plant, it is added at 0.001 kg/t of ore in the flotation circuit.
nodes.text: Barrett No. 4 Oil (масло Баррет № 4, Barrett #4 oil)

nodes.name: Dowfroth-250
nodes.definition: A commercial frother reagent (polypropylene glycol type) used in flotation of copper, pyrrhotitic, antimonial, and telluride gold ores to improve bubble stability and provide selective froth formation.
nodes.text: Dowfroth-250 (доуфрос-250, Dowfroth 250)

nodes.name: Jaw Crusher
nodes.definition: A primary crusher that uses compressive force between a fixed and a moving jaw to crush rock. It is used in the first stage of ore comminution in mineral processing plants.
nodes.text: Jaw Crusher (щековая дробилка)

nodes.name: Cone Crusher
nodes.definition: A secondary or tertiary crusher that uses a rotating cone within a conical chamber to crush ore by compression and attrition. It is commonly used in closed circuit with vibrating screens for size reduction.
nodes.text: Cone Crusher (конусная дробилка)

nodes.name: Spiral Classifier
nodes.definition: A device for wet classification of pulp by particle size, using a rotating spiral to lift settled sands. In the slice it is used for desliming and sand-slime separation, including at the Portovelo and La Luz Mines plants.
nodes.text: Spiral Classifier (спиральный классификатор)

nodes.name: Denver Sub-A Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: A widely used mechanical flotation machine with subaeration, capable of additional air injection. Used for polymetallic gold-silver ores at plants such as Batuung Bahey and Hillgrove, with specific models Denver-200 and Denver-300 employed at Copper Rand.
nodes.text: Denver Sub-A Flotation Machine (Денвер Суб-А, Denver Sub-A, Denver-200, Denver-300, Denver subaeration machine)

nodes.name: Steam Dryer
nodes.definition: A drying apparatus that uses steam as the heating medium to remove moisture from solids. In the Giant Yellowknife CIL circuit, a steam dryer reduces the moisture content of loaded activated carbon to about 7% before packaging.
nodes.text: Steam Dryer (паровая сушилка, steam-heated dryer)

nodes.name: Giant Yellowknife Plant (Canada)
nodes.definition: A Canadian gold processing plant (1100-1200 t/d) in the Northwest Territories, treating quartz-sulfide ore with up to 10% sulfides (pyrite, arsenopyrite, pyrrhotite, stibnite, chalcopyrite, galena) and gold mainly associated with arsenopyrite. Uses gravity, flotation, and two-stage fluidized bed roasting before cyanidation.
nodes.text: Giant Yellowknife Plant (Canada) (фабрика Джайент Иеллоунайф (Канада), Giant Yellowknife gold plant)

nodes.name: Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines (ET Cons)
nodes.definition: A South African mining company operating gold mines in the Barberton region, including Sheba, Agnes, and New Consort. The company utilized two-stage fluidized bed roasting for refractory gold-arsenic concentrates.
nodes.text: Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines (ET Cons) (ET Cons, Eastern Transvaal Consolidated Mines, East Transvaal Consolidated)

nodes.name: Electrostatic Precipitator (Roasting Gas Cleaning)
nodes.definition: Пылеулавливающий аппарат, использующий электрическое поле для осаждения тонкодисперсных частиц из отходящих газов обжиговых печей. Улавливает субмикронные фракции As₂O₃ и других возгонов.
nodes.text: Electrostatic Precipitator (Roasting Gas Cleaning) (электрофильтр, электрофильтр для очистки газов обжига)

nodes.name: Rosting Plant Tailings Treatment Unit
nodes.definition: Industrial hydrometallurgical unit for recovering gold from aged calcine-cyanidation tailings. Capacity 40 t/d, processing cost 15 Zimbabwe dollars per ton.
nodes.text: Rosting Plant Tailings Treatment Unit (установка по извлечению золота из лежалых хвостов цианирования огарков)
aliases: установка по извлечению золота из лежалых хвостов цианирования огарков

nodes.name: Tailings Reprocessing
nodes.definition: The recovery of residual valuable minerals from historical or current tailings using modern processing methods such as desliming, flotation, or cyanidation. It can be economically viable for large tonnages of low-grade material.
nodes.text: Tailings Reprocessing (переработка хвостов)

nodes.name: Processing Cost per Ton of Ore
nodes.definition: The total operating cost incurred to process one metric ton of ore, including all stages from crushing to final product. It is a key economic indicator for mine profitability. In the Arctic plant, it was 18.6 USD/t including mining and transport.
nodes.text: Processing Cost per Ton of Ore (себестоимость переработки 1 т руды)

nodes.name: Kochkarsky Roasting Plant (KOC)
nodes.definition: Russian industrial plant producing arsenic trioxide, metallic arsenic, and arsenic-based ligatures from gold-bearing concentrates. The plant operates a multi-hearth furnace, electrostatic precipitators, and condensation chambers for arsenic recovery.
nodes.text: Kochkarsky Roasting Plant (KOC) (КОЗ, Кочкарский обжиговый завод)

nodes.name: 7-Hearth Furnace G-38
nodes.definition: Multi-hearth roasting furnace with a total hearth area of 107 m², used at the Kochkarsky plant for oxidative roasting of gold-arsenic concentrates at controlled temperature.
nodes.text: 7-Hearth Furnace G-38 (печь Г-38, 7-подовая печь Г-38)

nodes.name: Getchell Mine (Nevada, USA)
nodes.definition: Gold mine in Nevada, USA, processing highly refractory ores containing arsenopyrite, realgar, orpiment, pyrrhotite, and stibnite. Originally used oxidative roasting followed by cyanidation; after 1989 adopted autoclave oxidation–CIL technology.
nodes.text: Getchell Mine (Nevada, USA) (рудник Гетчелл, Getchell plant)

nodes.name: Stibnite
nodes.definition: The principal antimony sulfide mineral in the slice. It is readily floated after activation with heavy-metal salts and can also be floated by apolar collectors when unactivated.
nodes.text: Stibnite (Sb2S3, antimonite, антимонит, сурьмяный блеск)

nodes.name: Ore Reserves (End of Year)
nodes.definition: The tonnage of ore that can be economically extracted from a mining lease at the end of a reporting period. It is a key resource indicator that declines as mining progresses.
nodes.text: Ore Reserves (End of Year) (запасы руды на конец периода, ore reserves in mining lease, remaining ore reserves)

nodes.name: Average Gold Grade in Reserves
nodes.definition: The mass fraction of gold in the ore reserves, usually expressed in grams per ton. It determines the economic value of the deposit and influences processing decisions.
nodes.text: Average Gold Grade in Reserves (среднее содержание Au в запасах, average gold grade of ore reserves)
aliases: average gold grade of ore reserves

nodes.name: Ergo Gold-Uranium Plant (South Africa)
nodes.definition: Золотодобывающий комплекс компании «Ист Рэнд Голд энд Ураниум» в ЮАР, на протяжении более 20 лет осуществляющий извлечение золота, урана и серы из лежалых хвостов обогащения в районе Ист Рэнд.
nodes.text: Ergo Gold-Uranium Plant (South Africa) (горнодобывающий комплекс Эрго (ЮАР), Ergo plant, East Rand Gold and Uranium)

nodes.name: Old Tailings
nodes.definition: Previously processed residue that may be re-agglomerated or re-leached in heap operations. The text notes that old tailings can be mixed with ore for pelletization or subjected to renewed heap leaching.
nodes.text: Old Tailings (старые хвосты, хвосты золотоизвлекательных фабрик)

nodes.name: Sodium Diuranate
nodes.definition: An intermediate uranium compound (Na₂U₂O₇) obtained during hydrometallurgical processing of uranium leach solutions after solvent extraction and precipitation. It is the final marketable uranium product from uranium recovery circuits at plants such as Ergo.
nodes.text: Sodium Diuranate (диуранат натрия, Na₂U₂O₇, uranium yellow cake intermediate)

nodes.name: Carbon-in-Leach (CIL)
nodes.definition: A combined hydrometallurgical process in which cyanide leaching of gold and silver is carried out simultaneously with adsorption of the dissolved metals onto activated carbon added directly to the pulp. It is used to minimize the sorption of precious metals by naturally occurring carbonaceous matter in the ore.
nodes.text: Carbon-in-Leach (CIL) (CIL, уголь в выщелачивание, совмещенный процесс выщелачивания и сорбции углем)
aliases: совмещенный процесс выщелачивания и сорбции углем

nodes.name: Sodium Mercaptobenzothiazole
nodes.definition: A water-soluble anionic collector reagent used in sulfide flotation, particularly for pyrite and gold-bearing sulfides. Adsorbs on mineral surfaces via the thiol group, increasing hydrophobicity and promoting separation. Commonly used in bulk sulfide flotation circuits.
nodes.text: Sodium Mercaptobenzothiazole (натриевая соль меркаптобензотиазола, NaMBT, sodium mercaptobenzothiazole flotation collector)

nodes.name: Vanadium Pentoxide
nodes.definition: V₂O₅-based catalyst used in the contact sulfuric‑acid process for the oxidation of SO₂ to SO₃. At the Ergo plant, vanadium pentoxide is the active component of the catalyst bed in the converters.
nodes.text: Vanadium Pentoxide (пентаоксид ванадия, V₂O₅, vanadium pentoxide catalyst)

nodes.name: Oxidative-Dissociation Roasting
nodes.definition: A roasting process carried out in a limited‑air (weakly oxidizing) atmosphere to promote thermal dissociation of sulfides (e.g., FeS₂ → FeSₓ + S₂, FeAsS → FeS + As₄) rather than complete oxidation. The liberated arsenic and sulfur are subsequently oxidized to volatile As₂O₃ and SO₂, enabling high arsenic removal (97–98 %) while keeping partial sulfur elimination (50–75 %). Used in the Salzin plant for gold‑arsenic concentrates.
nodes.text: Oxidative-Dissociation Roasting (окислительно-диссоциирующий обжиг, диссоциирующий обжиг с окислением)

nodes.name: Briquetting
nodes.definition: Agglomeration method in which fine coal is compacted into larger mechanically stable briquettes. It is used to improve handling, reduce dusting, and create commercial fuel products from fine or low-grade coal.
nodes.text: Briquetting (брикетирование угля, брикетирование)

nodes.name: Contact Sulfuric‑Acid Process
nodes.definition: A catalytic process in which SO₂ from roasting off‑gases is oxidised to SO₃ over a vanadium pentoxide catalyst, and the SO₃ is then absorbed in concentrated sulfuric acid to produce additional acid. At the Ergo complex, this method achieves 99.7 % SO₂ conversion and an overall sulfur recovery of 94 %.
nodes.text: Contact Sulfuric‑Acid Process (контактный метод производства серной кислоты, contact process for H₂SO₄)

nodes.name: Arsenic Trioxide Crystallizer Chamber
nodes.definition: A cooled chamber in which arsenic‑trioxide‑laden gases from the oxidation chamber are controlled‑cooled to precipitate crystalline As₂O₃ of 99.5 % purity. The product is packaged in drums for sale.
nodes.text: Arsenic Trioxide Crystallizer Chamber (камера кристаллизации триоксида мышьяка, As₂O₃ crystallisation chamber)

nodes.name: Salzin Plant (Cova Seiko, Spain)
nodes.definition: An industrial plant that processed pyritic and arsenopyritic gold concentrates by oxidative roasting and smelting of the calcine to copper matte for gold recovery, representing a non-cyanide route.
nodes.text: Salzin Plant (Cova Seiko, Spain) (завод Сальсинь, Salzin plant, Cova Seiko Salzin refinery)

nodes.name: Rio Tinto Gold-Silver Plant (Spain)
nodes.definition: An industrial gold-silver processing plant in Spain, commissioned in 1971, with a capacity of 4,800 t/d. Processes typical iron hat ore (hematite, limonite) with 2.2–2.4 g/t Au and 38 g/t Ag, achieving 90% gold and 40% silver recovery.
nodes.text: Rio Tinto Gold-Silver Plant (Spain) (Cerro Colorado Mill, Cerro Colorado plant, Rio Tinto concentrator (Spain), Rio Tinto plant, фабрика Рио Тнито)

nodes.name: Quartz-Tourmaline Ore
nodes.definition: Gold-bearing ore composed mainly of quartz and tourmaline, processed at the Sigma plant (Canada). Gold occurs in various degrees of dissemination, with a predominance of fine and ultrafine particles in quartz.
nodes.text: Quartz-Tourmaline Ore (кварцево-турмалиновая руда, gold-bearing quartz-tourmaline ore)

nodes.name: Three-Stage Grinding
nodes.definition: A comminution flowsheet involving three successive grinding stages (rod mill, ball mill, and pebble mill) to achieve very fine particle size (e.g., 80% passing 0.044 mm). Used at the Sigma and Rio Tinto plants for preparing refractory gold-silver ores.
nodes.text: Three-Stage Grinding (трехстадиальное измельчение, three-stage grinding circuit)

nodes.name: Pebble Mill
nodes.definition: A grinding mill that uses ore pebbles instead of steel balls as grinding media, used in the third grinding stage at the Sigma plant for fine grinding in cyanide solution.
nodes.text: Pebble Mill (рудногалечная мельница, ore-pebble mill)

nodes.name: Detour Lake Gold Plant
nodes.definition: A 2200 t/d gold processing plant in Canada, owned by Placer Dome, using semi‑autogenous grinding with steel balls, aeration for pyrrhotite neutralization, and carbon‑in‑pulp (CIP) cyanidation with electrolytic gold recovery from eluates.
nodes.text: Detour Lake Gold Plant (Detour Lake concentrator, Detour Lake CIP plant)

nodes.name: Dilnite Plant
nodes.definition: A gold processing plant where hydrocyclone desliming of second-stage flotation tailings was applied. Overflow containing 99% minus 0.074 mm with 0.41 g/t Au was discarded, and underflow (66% of feed, 1.61 g/t Au) was sent to third-stage flotation.
nodes.text: Dilnite Plant (Dilnite gold plant (Canada), фабрика Дилнайт)

nodes.name: Copper Rand Plant
nodes.definition: A Canadian copper-gold processing plant (3100 t/d) treating complex pyrrhotite-bearing ores by gravity-flotation to produce concentrate for smelting. Gold is mainly associated with pyrite.
nodes.text: Copper Rand Plant (Copper Rand concentrator (Canada), фабрика Коппер Рэнд)

nodes.name: Hot Alkaline Cyanide Desorption of Activated Carbon
nodes.definition: Процесс десорбции золота и серебра с насыщенного активированного угля путём обработки горячим раствором NaOH и NaCN. На фабрике Карлин уголь с загрузкой 5,15 г Au/кг передаётся на вторую фабрику для этой операции.
nodes.text: Hot Alkaline Cyanide Desorption of Activated Carbon (обработка горячими щелочными цианистыми растворами, hot caustic cyanide elution)

nodes.name: Hypochlorite-Lime Cyanide Detoxification
nodes.definition: A wastewater treatment method in which chlorine gas is reacted with lime to form hypochlorite pulp, which is then used to oxidize free and complexed cyanides in process effluents to less toxic cyanates and eventually to carbon dioxide and nitrogen. It is highly effective but consumes large amounts of chlorine and lime.
nodes.text: Hypochlorite-Lime Cyanide Detoxification (гипохлоритная детоксикация цианидов, обезвреживание цианистых стоков хлорной известью, chlorine-lime cyanide destruction)

nodes.name: Combined Gravity–Flotation Scheme
nodes.definition: A hybrid beneficiation flowsheet that integrates gravity concentration (e.g., jigging, tabling) with flotation to recover valuable minerals that are poorly floatable or require preconcentration. It is especially applied to oxidized antimony ores and gold ores with a mix of hydrophobic and dense minerals.
nodes.text: Combined Gravity–Flotation Scheme (гравитационно-флотационная схема, комбинированная гравитационно-флотационная технология, gravity-flotation technology)

nodes.name: Separate Sands and Slimes Flotation
nodes.definition: A flotation flowsheet in which coarse sand fractions and fine slime fractions are conditioned and floated separately. The slice presents this scheme as especially effective for disseminated copper ores with aggregated sulfide intergrowths and strong slime effects.
nodes.text: Separate Sands and Slimes Flotation (раздельная флотация песков и шламов, раздельная флотация песков и шламов руд)
aliases: раздельная флотация песков и шламов руд

nodes.name: Multi‑Stage Cyanidation with Intermediate Dewatering
nodes.definition: A cyanidation scheme in which the pulp is leached in several sequential stages, with complete solid‑liquid separation and replacement of the cyanide solution between stages. It is used for high‑grade concentrates to maintain a high leaching driving force and to remove impurities that accumulate in the solution.
nodes.text: Multi‑Stage Cyanidation with Intermediate Dewatering (многостадиальное цианирование с промежуточным обезвоживанием, staged cyanidation with solution change)

nodes.name: Zinc Dust Precipitation
nodes.definition: A hydrometallurgical recovery method in which gold and silver are precipitated from clarified cyanide solutions by adding zinc dust. The resulting gold-silver sludge is filtered, acid-treated, dried, roasted, and smelted to Dore metal.
nodes.text: Zinc Dust Precipitation (Merrill-Crowe precipitation, Merrill-Crowe process, Merrill‑Crowe process, gold cementation with zinc dust, Меррил‑Кроу, осаждение цинковой пылью)

nodes.name: Hydrocyclone Classifier
nodes.definition: A centrifugal hydraulic classifier used to separate slurry into coarse and fine fractions by particle size and density. In flotation preparation circuits it is applied for classification and slime removal prior to conditioning and flotation.
nodes.text: Hydrocyclone Classifier (классификатор-гидроциклон, гидроциклон, гидроциклонный классификатор)

nodes.name: Rod Mill
nodes.definition: A grinding mill that uses long steel rods as the grinding media, suitable for coarse grinding and achieving a relatively narrow product size distribution. In gold ore processing, it is often used in the first grinding stage; at the Cannon plant it feeds a carbon flotation section.
nodes.text: Rod Mill (стержневая мельница, rod grinding mill)

nodes.name: Two-Chamber Jigging Machine
nodes.definition: A gravity concentration device with two compartments used to recover native copper from the grinding circuit discharge before flotation. Installed at the Horseshoe plant to capture coarse copper particles and prevent cyanicide losses.
nodes.text: Two-Chamber Jigging Machine (двухкамерная отсадочная машина, two-compartment jig)

nodes.name: Pyrrhotite-Bearing Gold Ore
nodes.definition: Gold ore containing pyrrhotite, which consumes oxygen and cyanide during cyanidation, generates acidity, and produces thiosulfate and other sulfur species that can inhibit gold dissolution. These ores often require pre-aeration or oxidative roasting.
nodes.text: Pyrrhotite-Bearing Gold Ore (pyrrhotitic gold ore, пирротинсодержащие золотые руды)

nodes.name: Chalcopyrite
nodes.definition: Copper iron sulfide mineral referenced as weakly affected by copper sulfate treatment. Its surface state strongly influences collector adsorption and flotation behavior.
nodes.text: Chalcopyrite (CuFeS2, халькопирит)

nodes.name: Hydrogen Peroxide
nodes.definition: An oxidizing reagent used to pre-oxidize sulfide concentrates before selective flotation. In the slice it is especially effective in combination with dichromate for separating cinnabar from stibnite.
nodes.text: Hydrogen Peroxide (перекись водорода, H2O2)

nodes.name: Desorption Temperature 90 °C
nodes.definition: Operating temperature for hot caustic cyanide elution of loaded activated carbon. At 90 °C with 10 g/L NaOH and 2 g/L NaCN, gold is desorbed to residual <155 g/t in a 60‑hour circulation cycle.
nodes.text: Desorption Temperature 90 °C (температура десорбции 90 °C, 90 °C cyanide desorption)

nodes.name: Gold Grade
nodes.definition: Mass concentration of gold in ore, usually expressed in grams per ton. It is the key technical indicator used to assess ore quality and to compare the economic attractiveness of placer and lode deposits.
nodes.text: Gold Grade (содержание золота, содержание золота в руде, Au grade, г/т золота)

nodes.name: Overall Gold Recovery
nodes.definition: The fraction of gold in the mined ore that is transferred into the final product, integrating all beneficiation stages. In the slice, the Itogon plant achieved 86.8% overall recovery from a pyritic ore.
nodes.text: Overall Gold Recovery (общее извлечение золота, overall gold extraction)

nodes.name: Steel Rod Consumption
nodes.definition: Mass of grinding rods consumed per ton of ore or concentrate in a rod mill. At the Getchell plant (historical, 1960s) consumption was 0.54 kg/t of ore.
nodes.text: Steel Rod Consumption (расход стержней, расход стальных стержней)

nodes.name: Native Gold
nodes.definition: Natural metallic gold, the primary valuable mineral. Density 15.6–18.3 g/cm³, hardness 2–3, malleable, non-magnetic. Not directly depressing but its surface may be passivated by associated minerals.
nodes.text: Native Gold (золото самородное, Au)

nodes.name: Native Silver
nodes.definition: Natural metallic silver. Density 10.1–11.1 g/cm³, hardness 2.5–3, very malleable, non-magnetic, conductive.
nodes.text: Native Silver (серебро самородное, Ag)

nodes.name: Sphalerite
nodes.definition: Zinc sulfide mineral whose flotation properties can be significantly altered by copper sulfate activation. It is a key sulfide mineral in selective flotation circuits.
nodes.text: Sphalerite (ZnS, сфалерит)

nodes.name: Limonite
nodes.definition: Hydrated iron oxide mineral, a common weathering product. Causes physical depression of gold and silver during cyanidation. Density 3.3–4.0 g/cm³, hardness 4–5, brittle, moderately magnetic.
nodes.text: Limonite (лимонит, Fe2O3·H2O·aq)

nodes.name: Native Copper
nodes.definition: Naturally occurring metallic copper that occurs in some oxidized copper-gold ores. It is recovered by gravity concentration before flotation to prevent excessive cyanide consumption and to improve overall copper recovery.
nodes.text: Native Copper (Cu, metallic copper, медь самородная, самородная медь)

nodes.name: Chrysocolla
nodes.definition: Hydrated copper silicate mineral included among oxidized copper-bearing minerals. It is important in flotation because its surface is strongly hydrated and often requires special treatment for recovery.
nodes.text: Chrysocolla (CuSiO3·nH2O, хризоколла)

nodes.name: Malachite
nodes.definition: A copper carbonate mineral mentioned as being activated by very small doses of sodium silicate in flotation. It is relevant as an oxide/carbonate copper mineral whose surface chemistry can change markedly under regulator treatment.
nodes.text: Malachite (CuCO3·Cu(OH)2, малахит)

nodes.name: Azurite
nodes.definition: Copper carbonate mineral included among oxidized copper minerals. It is important in flotation as an example of a hydrophilic oxidized phase that requires specialized collectors or activation.
nodes.text: Azurite (2CuCO3·Cu(OH)2, азурит)

nodes.name: Iron Hydroxides
nodes.definition: Insoluble iron-containing precipitates formed when iron ions are removed from solution by alkali addition. In flotation, iron hydroxides are used to suppress unwanted iron-ion activation and to reduce the adverse influence of dissolved iron species on reagent selectivity.
nodes.text: Iron Hydroxides (гидроокиси железа, гидроксиды железа, нерастворимые гидроокиси железа)

nodes.name: Amyl Xanthate
nodes.definition: Higher-chain xanthate collector used for sulfide mineral flotation. The slice shows that its performance can be further improved by combining it with dithiophosphate, although the synergy depends on reagent ratio and mineral surface state.
nodes.text: Amyl Xanthate (амиловый ксантогенат, amyl xanthogenate)

nodes.name: S-4037 Collector
nodes.definition: Synthetic organic flotation collector reagent (type S-4037) used in copper-gold flotation circuits. Added as a supplementary collector to improve recovery of copper and gold, typically dosed at 0.02 kg/t of ore.
nodes.text: S-4037 Collector (S-4037 (собиратель), S-4037)

nodes.name: Methyl Isobutyl Carbinol
nodes.definition: A secondary alcohol widely used as a high-efficiency frother in ore and coal flotation. The text emphasizes its high selectivity and its positive effect on concentrate quality and recovery.
nodes.text: Methyl Isobutyl Carbinol (метилизобутилкарбинол, МИБК, MIBC)

nodes.name: Aeroflot-N
nodes.definition: A type of dithiophosphate flotation collector (aerofloat) used in selective flotation of copper-gold ores. Applied at a rate of 20 g/t in alkaline pH (9.4–9.6) at the Oiankos plant to hydrophobize sulfide minerals.
nodes.text: Aeroflot-N (аэрофлот-Н, Aeroflot N)

nodes.name: Aeroxanthate 301
nodes.definition: A commercial xanthate-based flotation collector (type 301) used for bulk or selective flotation of copper and gold sulfides. Dosed at 60 g/t at the Oiankos plant as part of the collector suite.
nodes.text: Aeroxanthate 301 (аэроксантогенат 301, Aero xanthate 301)

nodes.name: Aeroflot 208
nodes.definition: A dithiophosphate flotation collector (aerofloat 208) used in copper-gold flotation. Applied at 60 g/t in the Oiankos flowsheet to enhance recovery of copper and gold minerals.
nodes.text: Aeroflot 208 (аэрофлот 208)

nodes.name: Marcy Ball Mill
nodes.definition: A brand of ball mill (size 2.74×3.66 m) used for grinding copper-gold ore to flotation feed fineness (70–75 % passing 0.074 mm). Two such mills are used in parallel for gold and gold-copper ore circuits at the Horseshoe plant.
nodes.text: Marcy Ball Mill (шаровая мельница “Марси”, Marcy mill, мельница Марси)

nodes.name: Maxwell Flotation Cell
nodes.definition: Large-volume flotation cell (20–60 m³) used in the rougher flotation of gold-copper ores at Canadian plants such as Pamour Porcupine and Copper Rand. It is characterized by low energy consumption and simplified maintenance.
nodes.text: Maxwell Flotation Cell (машина Максвелла, MX-10, MX-12, MX-14, Maxwell cell)

nodes.name: Thickener
nodes.definition: A settling vessel used to separate gold-bearing solution from the solid part of the pulp after cyanidation. The overflow is sent for gold recovery, and the underflow is further processed.
nodes.text: Thickener (сгуститель, чан-сгуститель)

nodes.name: Lasta Automatic Filter Press
nodes.definition: Automatic chamber filter press with 22 chambers and 77 m² total filtration area, used to dewater flotation concentrate. Achieves 8 % cake moisture and reduced operating costs by 26 000 USD per month at the Copper Rand plant.
nodes.text: Lasta Automatic Filter Press (автоматический фильтр-пресс “Ласта”, Lasta filter press, фильтр-пресс Ласта)

nodes.name: Fagergren Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: Widely used chamber-type flotation machine with a rod rotor-stator aeration system. It provides high pulp aeration at low specific energy consumption and can operate with low pulp depth while maintaining effective froth removal.
nodes.text: Fagergren Flotation Machine (флотационная машина «Фагергрен», машина «Фагергрен», Fagergren machine)

nodes.name: Agitair-48 Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: A pneumatic-mechanical flotation machine with forced air supply and mechanical agitation, used for flotation of low-sulfide and oxidized ores at plants like Horoshu and Yellow Pine. It allows independent control of aeration intensity.
nodes.text: Agitair-48 Flotation Machine (Аджитейер-48, Agitair 48, Agitair flotation cell)

nodes.name: Disc Vacuum Filter
nodes.definition: Continuous vacuum filter constructed from disc-shaped filtration elements operating under vacuum. It belongs to the class of vacuum filters used for granular pulps and offers high filtration area per unit footprint.
nodes.text: Disc Vacuum Filter (дисковый вакуум-фильтр, дисковый вакуумный фильтр)

nodes.name: Hammer Crusher
nodes.definition: A size‑reduction machine in which material is broken by impact from rapidly rotating hammers. Used for secondary or tertiary crushing of medium‑hard and friable ores before grinding. Referenced in the Berengela plant flowsheet for comminution of roasted calcine.
nodes.text: Hammer Crusher (молотковая дробилка, hammermill crusher)

nodes.name: Column Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: Pneumatic flotation machine with a chamber in the form of a column. The slice lists it as one of the main machine configurations used for air introduction and separation.
nodes.text: Column Flotation Machine (колонная флотационная машина, флотационная колонна)

nodes.name: Froth Flotation
nodes.definition: Modern flotation scheme in which air bubbles, collectors, and frothers are used to transport hydrophobic particles into a stable froth layer. It enabled economically viable and selective separation of fine and polymetallic ores.
nodes.text: Froth Flotation (пенная флотация)

nodes.name: Selective Flotation
nodes.definition: Flotation mode designed to separate multiple valuable minerals into individual concentrates. It relies on finely tuned reagent chemistry and differences in surface selectivity.
nodes.text: Selective Flotation (селективная флотация)

nodes.name: Staged Flotation
nodes.definition: A flotation flowsheet organized as alternating grinding and flotation stages. This arrangement extracts liberated mineral particles progressively as intergrowths are broken down.
nodes.text: Staged Flotation (стадийная флотация, схемы стадийной флотации)

nodes.name: Dewatering
nodes.definition: Комплекс операций по отделению жидкой фазы от хвостов, концентратов или продуктов выщелачивания. В гидрометаллургии включает сгущение, декантацию и фильтрацию и применяется для снижения потерь реагентов и извлекаемых металлов.
nodes.text: Dewatering (обезвоживание, операции обезвоживания)

nodes.name: Grinding in Cyanide Solution
nodes.definition: A hydrometallurgical intensification method in which ore is ground in the presence of cyanide solution rather than in water. This initiates gold and silver leaching during comminution, shortens overall cyanidation residence time, allows efficient internal recycling of barren solutions, and can reduce total cyanide consumption.
nodes.text: Grinding in Cyanide Solution (измельчение в цианистой среде, измельчение в присутствии цианидов, cyanide grinding, измельчение в цианистых растворах)

nodes.name: Multi-Chamber Mechanical Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: A flotation machine consisting of several mechanically agitated chambers arranged in series, used for continuous countercurrent sorption-flotation processes. It is employed to recover loaded powdered activated carbon from cyanide or thiocarbamide pulps.
nodes.text: Multi-Chamber Mechanical Flotation Machine (многокамерная флотационная машина механического типа, ten-chamber flotation machine, десятикамерная флотомашина)

nodes.name: Autogenous Mill
nodes.definition: Grinding mill in which the ore itself serves as the grinding media without added steel balls or rods. It is used for coarse size reduction in a single stage, reducing steel consumption and wear, but requires competent ore for effective grinding.
nodes.text: Autogenous Mill (self-grinding mill, мельница самоизмельчения)

nodes.name: Copper Concentrate Grade
nodes.definition: The mass fraction of copper in a flotation concentrate, typically expressed as percent or in decimal form. The text notes that high‑quality concentrates from segregation roasting can reach 40–60 % copper.
nodes.text: Copper Concentrate Grade (содержание меди в концентрате, качество медного концентрата, grade of copper concentrate)

nodes.name: Cake Moisture
nodes.definition: Residual water content retained in the filter cake after filtration. The slice notes that flocculating additives such as polyacrylamide can increase cake moisture because of water retained inside flocs, even while they improve filtration rate.
nodes.text: Cake Moisture (влажность кека, остаточная влажность осадка)

nodes.name: Granulometric Composition
nodes.definition: Particle-size distribution of the solid phase in an ore or pulp. It strongly affects mixing, slime formation, conditioning behavior, and the flotation response of the feed.
nodes.text: Granulometric Composition (гранулометрическая характеристика, гранулометрический состав)

nodes.name: Collector Cost
nodes.definition: Economic indicator describing the cost of flotation collectors per unit mass or process unit. The slice states that apolar collectors are several times cheaper than ionogenic reagents, making collector cost a key driver for reagent selection and process economics.
nodes.text: Collector Cost (стоимость собирателя, стоимость аполярных собирателей, затраты на собиратели)

nodes.name: Closed Circuit
nodes.definition: A processing configuration in which intermediate products are returned to the initial flotation cycles for reprocessing. It is preferred when the recycle stream does not negatively affect pulp conditions or separation efficiency.
nodes.text: Closed Circuit (замкнутый цикл, в замкнутом цикле)

nodes.name: Opemiska Plant (Canada)
nodes.definition: Canadian gold-copper processing plant owned by Falconbridge, operating since 1963 at 2 540–2 700 t/d. Processes ore averaging 2.8 g/t Au, 8.7 g/t Ag, 1.16 % Cu with flotation to produce a concentrate for the Noranda smelter. Gold recovery 89.6 %.
nodes.text: Opemiska Plant (Canada) (фабрика Опемиска (Канада), Opemiska concentrator, Falconbridge Opemiska)

nodes.name: Horseshoe Plant (Australia)
nodes.definition: Australian gold-copper processing plant (commissioned 1984) treating gold ores by direct cyanidation/CIP (400 t/d) and gold-copper ores by gravity-flotation (700 t/d). Gold-copper ore grade: 3.9 g/t Au, 35 g/t Ag, 4.1 % Cu. Uses sequential sulfide-oxide flotation with 16 Agitair cells.
nodes.text: Horseshoe Plant (Australia) (фабрика Хорсшу (Австралия), Horseshoe concentrator, Horoshu plant)

nodes.name: Oiankos Plant (Chile)
nodes.definition: Chilean gold-copper processing plant (300 t/d) treating mixed sulfide-oxidized ores from several deposits. Ore contains 11–14 g/t Au, 0.6–1.4 % Cu with chalcopyrite, chrysocolla, malachite, azurite, atacamite, and native copper. Uses sequential flotation with aeroflot reagents at pH 9.4–9.6 and grinding in weak cyanide solution.
nodes.text: Oiankos Plant (Chile) (фабрика Оянкос (Чили), Oiancos concentrator, Oiancos plant)

nodes.name: Chalcocite
nodes.definition: Copper sulfide mineral that can form as a secondary surface phase during mineral alteration. In flotation, it is relevant because it can coat primary sulfides and change their collector response.
nodes.text: Chalcocite (Cu2S, халькозин)

nodes.name: Bornite
nodes.definition: A copper iron sulfide mineral (Cu5FeS4) commonly associated with gold in copper-gold ores. It is a significant copper mineral that can be recovered by flotation and, in the context of the slice, appears in synthetic mixtures studied for combined flotation-thiocarbamide leaching.
nodes.text: Bornite (Cu3FeS4, Cu5FeS4, copper iron sulfide, peacock ore, борнит)

nodes.name: Sericite
nodes.definition: A fine-grained muscovite mica mineral commonly occurring in alteration zones of gold-antimony ores. Its presence in high content complicates flotation by causing slime interference and requiring staged grinding and desliming operations.
nodes.text: Sericite (серицит, sericite mica)

nodes.name: Feldspar
nodes.definition: Rock-forming aluminosilicate mineral that is commonly separated from quartz, kaolin, and mica by flotation. The slice cites feldspar in multiple cationic-collector separation examples.
nodes.text: Feldspar (полевой шпат, полевые шпаты)

nodes.name: Intensive Cyanidation
nodes.definition: A short but high-intensity cyanidation process followed by rapid separation of the gold-bearing solution from the pulp or by sorption of the metal from the pulp using synthetic granular sorbents. It is used to minimize gold adsorption by carbonaceous matter.
nodes.text: Intensive Cyanidation (интенсивное цианистое выщелачивание, интенсивное цианирование)

nodes.name: Regrinding
nodes.definition: Additional grinding applied to concentrates, tailings, or intermediate products after an initial flotation pass. It is used to increase liberation before further flotation or separation.
nodes.text: Regrinding (доизмельчение, переизмельчение промежуточных продуктов)

nodes.name: Gravity Concentrate Upgrading
nodes.definition: A finishing operation for gravity concentrates that removes remaining gangue and sulfides to produce a high-grade product suitable for direct smelting or refining. It typically uses tabling, magnetic separation, or intensive cyanidation.
nodes.text: Gravity Concentrate Upgrading (глубокая доводка гравиоконцентратов, gravity concentrate cleaning, upgrading of gravity gold concentrate)

nodes.name: Denver Cyanidation Agitator
nodes.definition: Механический агитатор (фирмы Денвер), используемый для интенсивного цианирования пульпы. В тексте упоминается 7 последовательно установленных агитаторов объёмом 5,5×5,5 м для переработки хвостов флотации.
nodes.text: Denver Cyanidation Agitator (Denver agitator, агитатор Денвера)

nodes.name: Exhauster Fan
nodes.definition: A fan or blower that extracts flue gases or vapours from process equipment, maintaining negative pressure. In the Berengela segregation‑roasting furnace, an exhauster removes excess gases above the recirculating stream to the stack.
nodes.text: Exhauster Fan (эксгаустер, induction fan, exhaust fan for roasting gases)

nodes.name: DO-600 Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: Флотационная машина с камерой объёмом 17 м³, применяемая для коллективной сульфидной флотации на комплексе Олимпик Дэм.
nodes.text: DO-600 Flotation Machine (ДО-600, флотационная машина ДО-600)

nodes.name: Rubber-Lined Agitator
nodes.definition: Механический агитатор с резиновым покрытием (гуммированием), используемый для сернокислотного выщелачивания урана при закрытых крышках для ограничения доступа воздуха.
nodes.text: Rubber-Lined Agitator (гуммированный агитатор, резиновый агитатор)

nodes.name: Lead Nitrate Consumption
nodes.definition: Масса нитрата свинца, расходуемая на тонну руды при осаждении золота цинковой пылью из цианистых растворов. На фабрике Флин-Флон составляет 1,3 г/т руды.
nodes.text: Lead Nitrate Consumption (расход нитрата свинца)

nodes.name: Cyanide Regeneration Degree
nodes.definition: Отношение массы регенерированного цианида (в пересчёте на NaCN) к исходному содержанию. На фабрике Флин-Флон достигает 93,6% при суточной производительности 2250 т.
nodes.text: Cyanide Regeneration Degree (степень регенерации цианида)

nodes.name: Copper Thiocyanate Scaling
nodes.definition: Отложение тиоцианата меди (CuCNS) на элементах градирни в диспергирующей башне регенерации цианида, что снижает проходимость воздуха и требует замены секций каждые 3–4 месяца.
nodes.text: Copper Thiocyanate Scaling (тиоцианат меди, осаждение тиоцианата меди)

nodes.name: Gold-Antimony Ore
nodes.definition: A refractory ore containing gold together with antimony minerals, requiring combined processing methods such as flotation, roasting, and cyanidation.
nodes.text: Gold-Antimony Ore (золото-сурьмяная руда)

nodes.name: Diesel Oil
nodes.definition: A petroleum-derived hydrocarbon fraction used as a flotation frother and auxiliary collector, particularly in telluride gold ore flotation (e.g., Emperor plant). It acts as a hydrophobic bridging agent for fine particles.
nodes.text: Diesel Oil (дизельное масло, дизельное топливо)

nodes.name: Ethyl Xanthate
nodes.definition: Low-molecular xanthate collector used in sulfide flotation. In the slice, it is one of the reagents tested alone and in combination with dithiophosphate, where mixtures improved galena recovery relative to the single reagent.
nodes.text: Ethyl Xanthate (этиловый ксантогенат, ethyl xanthogenate)

nodes.name: Reichert Cone Separator
nodes.definition: Gravity concentration device consisting of a series of stacked, concentric cones through which slurry flows. It separates particles by density using centrifugal and film-flow forces, commonly used for gold and heavy-mineral recovery from ground ores.
nodes.text: Reichert Cone Separator (Reichert cone, конус Рейчерта)

nodes.name: Trommel
nodes.definition: A rotating cylindrical screen used for washing and size classification of ore. On the Portovelo plant, it had dimensions 0.9 m × 2.4 m with 6 mm and 32 mm perforations and a slope of 1:4.2.
nodes.text: Trommel (rotating drum screen, trommel screen, вращающийся грохот, троммель)

nodes.name: Filter Press
nodes.definition: Pressure filtration unit used to clarify cyanide solutions and to dewater gold-zinc precipitates. It produces a dense cake and clear filtrate, supporting solution recovery and downstream handling.
nodes.text: Filter Press (фильтр-пресс, рамный фильтр-пресс)

nodes.name: Antimony Recovery
nodes.definition: Process KPI representing the fraction of antimony transferred from ore to cathode antimony product. In the Sarylah pilot plant, overall recovery reached 96.1 % (98 % leaching, 98 % electrolysis).
nodes.text: Antimony Recovery (извлечение сурьмы)

nodes.name: Hillgrove Mill
nodes.definition: Antimony-gold processing plant in Australia, referenced in the context of thiocarbamide leaching technology.
nodes.text: Hillgrove Mill (Hillgrove mill (Australia))

nodes.name: Hillgrove Thiocarbamide Plant
nodes.definition: Industrial plant at the Hillgrove antimony-gold mine (Australia) that treats 8 t/day of concentrate (60% Sb, 30-40 g/t Au) with thiocarbamide leaching for 15 minutes. Gold is recovered from solutions by activated carbon sorption, and the de-golded antimony concentrate is sold.
nodes.text: Hillgrove Thiocarbamide Plant (фабрика Хиллгрув, Hillgrove TKВ plant)

nodes.name: Sarylah Antimony Factory
nodes.definition: Industrial facility processing Sarylah gold-antimony flotation concentrate (56% Sb, 28 g/t Au) using thiocarbamide leaching for gold recovery. The plant operated at semi-industrial scale and the concentrate feed was later processed at a dedicated antimony metallurgical plant.
nodes.text: Sarylah Antimony Factory (Сарылахская фабрика, Серебрянский комбинат)

nodes.name: Complex Processing of Gold-Antimony Ores
nodes.definition: An integrated processing approach combining gravity, flotation, leaching, and smelting to recover gold, antimony, and other valuable components.
nodes.text: Complex Processing of Gold-Antimony Ores (комплексная переработка золото-сурьмяных руд)

nodes.name: Ligature Gold
nodes.definition: Сплав золота с медью и железом, получаемый плавкой огарка золотой головки с флюсами. Содержит 84–91% Au, 8–15% Cu и 1–2% Fe и направляется на аффинажный завод для дальнейшей очистки.
nodes.text: Ligature Gold (лигатурное золото, gold-copper-iron alloy, ligature gold (84-91% Au, 8-15% Cu, 1-2% Fe))

nodes.name: Sulfide-Alkaline Leaching
nodes.definition: A hydrometallurgical pretreatment in which gold-antimony concentrates are treated with a solution of sodium sulfide and sodium hydroxide to selectively dissolve antimony minerals, leaving a gold-bearing residue for subsequent cyanidation.
nodes.text: Sulfide-Alkaline Leaching (alkaline sulfide leaching, alkaline sulfide leaching of antimony, сульфидно-щелочное выщелачивание)

nodes.name: Magnetic Separation
nodes.definition: Separation method that exploits differences in magnetic susceptibility of ore components. The slice mentions it as a common pre-flotation operation in gold-bearing ore preparation, used together with crushing, grinding, and classification.
nodes.text: Magnetic Separation (магнитная сепарация, магнитное обогащение)

nodes.name: Mechanical Flotation Machine
nodes.definition: Flotation machine in which an impeller mechanically sucks in and disperses air into the pulp. The slice identifies this as one of the principal machine classes and notes that it typically produces fine bubbles under optimal frother dosage.
nodes.text: Mechanical Flotation Machine (флотационная машина механического типа, механическая флотомашина)

nodes.name: Kadamjay Antimony Plant
nodes.definition: Металлургический завод в Киргизии, перерабатывавший сарылахские коллективные золото-сурьмяные концентраты по технологии сульфидно-щелочного выщелачивания с электролитическим извлечением сурьмы из растворов.
nodes.text: Kadamjay Antimony Plant (Кадамджайский сурьмяный комбинат, Камдажский сурьмяный завод, Kadamjay antimony refinery, Kadamdjay antimony plant)

nodes.name: Irgiredmet Institute
nodes.definition: A Russian research institute specializing in precious metals processing, referenced as the author's affiliation and a source of technological developments.
nodes.text: Irgiredmet Institute (ОАО 'Иргиредмет', Irkutsk Research Institute of Precious and Rare Metals and Diamonds)
aliases: Irkutsk Research Institute of Precious and Rare Metals and Diamonds

nodes.name: Silver Concentrate
nodes.definition: A flotation concentrate rich in silver minerals, often containing tetrahedrite, argentite, or native silver. It may be processed by hydrometallurgical methods (e.g., caustic leaching) to extract antimony and recover silver.
nodes.text: Silver Concentrate (серебряный концентрат)

nodes.name: Lead Concentrate
nodes.definition: A flotation product enriched in lead minerals, typically containing galena and associated silver. It is sent to a lead smelter for recovery of lead, silver, and other metals.
nodes.text: Lead Concentrate (свинцовый концентрат)

nodes.name: Isopropyl Xanthate
nodes.definition: A branched-chain xanthate collector mentioned in the slice as being stronger than the corresponding normal propyl xanthate in some cases. It illustrates how chain branching can improve collector action by more effectively disrupting hydrated surface layers near the mineral surface.
nodes.text: Isopropyl Xanthate (изопропиловый ксантогенат, изопропилксантогенат)

nodes.name: Isoamyl Xanthate
nodes.definition: A higher-chain xanthate collector used for flotation of sulfide minerals. It has stronger hydrophobizing action than ethyl or propyl xanthates and is applied in selective copper and zinc circuits.
nodes.text: Isoamyl Xanthate (изоамиловый ксантогенат)

nodes.name: Annual Silver Production
nodes.definition: The mass of silver produced in the final product per calendar year. At the Rio Tinto plant, annual silver production was 27 tonnes.
nodes.text: Annual Silver Production (silver output per year, годовая добыча серебра, годовое производство серебра)

nodes.name: Three-Stage Crushing
nodes.definition: A comminution flowsheet in which ore passes through three successive crushing stages (typically jaw, cone, and short-head cone or roll crushers) to reduce particle size before grinding. It is common in gold ore preparation for downstream beneficiation.
nodes.text: Three-Stage Crushing (трехстадиальное дробление, three-stage crushing circuit)

nodes.name: Grinding in Cyanide Solution
nodes.definition: A hydrometallurgical intensification method in which ore is ground in the presence of cyanide solution rather than in water. This initiates gold and silver leaching during comminution, shortens overall cyanidation residence time, allows efficient recycling of barren solutions, and can reduce total cyanide consumption.
nodes.text: Grinding in Cyanide Solution (измельчение в цианистых растворах, cyanide grinding, измельчение в цианистой среде)

nodes.name: Rake Classifier
nodes.definition: A mechanical classifier in which settled sands are raked up an inclined trough for discharge. It is used in closed-circuit grinding operations for size classification.
nodes.text: Rake Classifier (rake mechanical classifier, реечный классификатор)

nodes.name: Frame Clarifier
nodes.definition: A pressure filtration device composed of rectangular frames covered with filter cloth, used to remove fine suspended solids from cyanide solutions before Merrill‑Crowe precipitation. It produces a clear filtrate suitable for zinc dust cementation.
nodes.text: Frame Clarifier (рамный осветлитель, frame filter clarifier)

nodes.name: Mercury Vapor Toxicity
nodes.definition: A safety and environmental constraint associated with the handling and thermal distillation of mercury-containing amalgams. Toxic vapor emissions require closed equipment, controlled heating, and strict exposure limits in order to avoid occupational poisoning and environmental release.
nodes.text: Mercury Vapor Toxicity (токсичность паров ртути, ртутная токсичность)

nodes.name: Resin-in-Leach (RIL)
nodes.definition: A combined hydrometallurgical process in which cyanide leaching of gold and silver is carried out simultaneously with ion-exchange sorption of the dissolved metals from the pulp. It is applied to carbonaceous ores to reduce metal losses due to sorption by natural carbonaceous matter.
nodes.text: Resin-in-Leach (RIL) (RIL, смола в выщелачивание, совмещенный процесс выщелачивания и сорбции смолой)
aliases: совмещенный процесс выщелачивания и сорбции смолой

nodes.name: Sorption Pachuca Tank
nodes.definition: A tall, conical‑bottomed pneumatic agitation tank specifically designed for ion‑exchange sorption from cyanide pulps. It is used to contact the pulp with resin beads while maintaining suspension and aeration. At the Karamkenskaya plant, sorption pachucas have a diameter of 3.5 m, height of 16.5 m, and working volume of 100 m³, and are arranged in series for countercurrent resin‑pulp contact.
nodes.text: Sorption Pachuca Tank (сорбционный пачук, sorption pachuca, Pachuca tank for ion‑exchange sorption)

nodes.name: Kidd Creek Processing Plant
nodes.definition: A Canadian copper-zinc-silver processing plant in Ontario that treats complex ores containing precious metals. In the context of carbonaceous gold ore processing, it is mentioned as a plant where flotation concentrates are smelted on copper smelters.
nodes.text: Kidd Creek Processing Plant (Кидд Крик, Kidd Creek concentrator)

nodes.name: Jigging
nodes.definition: A gravity separation method in which a pulsating water flow stratifies particles by density and size on a screen or bed. Heavier grains move downward and are recovered as concentrate, while lighter grains report to tailings.
nodes.text: Jigging (отсадка, обогащение отсадкой)

nodes.name: Gold Purity
nodes.definition: Mass fraction of gold in a refined cathodic product or bullion. In gold electrorefining it is a primary quality indicator, and the slice reports cathodic gold of about 999.8–999.9 fineness.
nodes.text: Gold Purity (чистота золота, проба золота, assay of gold)

nodes.name: Express Technological Assessment Methodology
nodes.definition: A methodology developed by Irgiredmet for the rapid and low-cost assessment of gold and silver ores. It involves calculations, chemical-mineralogical analyses, and lab experiments to assign an ore to its Technological Variety, propose a processing scheme, and forecast extraction recoveries.
nodes.text: Express Technological Assessment Methodology (методика экспрессной технологической оценки руд, preliminary feasibility study method)

nodes.name: Technological Classification of Gold and Silver Ores
nodes.definition: A system developed by Irgiredmet for classifying gold and silver ores based on their response to cyanidation. Ores are divided into Technological Classes (TC), Technological Types (TT), and Technological Varieties (TV), with the variety being the main unit. Criteria include the relative value of gold and other valuable metals, and the nature and degree of process refractoriness.
nodes.text: Technological Classification of Gold and Silver Ores (технологическая классификация золото- и серебросодержащих руд, Irgiredmet classification)
aliases: технологическая классификация золото- и серебросодержащих руд

nodes.name: Relative Value of Gold in Ore
nodes.definition: A criterion for technological classification that assesses the economic contribution of gold compared to other valuable non-ferrous metals present in the ore. This determines which metal is the primary target and defines the Technological Class.
nodes.text: Relative Value of Gold in Ore (относительная ценность золота в исходной руде, economic value of gold vs. other metals)
aliases: относительная ценность золота в исходной руде
economic value of gold vs. other metals

nodes.name: Degree of Technological Refractoriness
nodes.definition: A criterion for technological classification that quantifies the difficulty of extracting gold and silver from an ore using conventional cyanidation. It determines the Technological Type and Variety, guiding the choice of treatment method (e.g., direct cyanidation or pretreatment like roasting).
nodes.text: Degree of Technological Refractoriness (степень технологической упорности руды в цианистом процессе, level of resistance to cyanidation)
aliases: степень технологической упорности руды в цианистом процессе

nodes.name: Principle Processing Scheme
nodes.definition: The basic technological pathway proposed for a specific Technological Variety of ore, including potential sub-variants for optimization. It serves as the conceptual design for the beneficiation process.
nodes.text: Principle Processing Scheme (принципиальная схема переработки, basic flowsheet)

nodes.name: Forecasted Gold and Silver Recovery
nodes.definition: An estimated KPI for the percentage of gold and silver that can be extracted from an ore into a final marketable product, based on the application of a standard processing scheme to a specific Technological Variety. It is used for preliminary economic evaluations.
nodes.text: Forecasted Gold and Silver Recovery (прогнозируемые показатели извлечения золота и серебра, expected extraction indicators)
aliases: прогнозируемые показатели извлечения золота и серебра

nodes.name: Techno-Economic Assessment of Ores
nodes.definition: A planned extension of the express technological assessment that includes forecasting specific processing costs per ton of ore. This is achieved by analyzing and generalizing technical and economic data from industrial plants that process similar Technological Varieties of ore.
nodes.text: Techno-Economic Assessment of Ores (технолого-экономическая оценка руд, economic evaluation of raw materials)

nodes.name: Lodeyshchikov, V. V. (1975) On the methodology of technological assessment of gold-bearing ores
nodes.definition: A paper presenting a methodology for the technological evaluation and classification of gold ores for process selection.
nodes.text: Lodeyshchikov, V. V. (1975) On the methodology of technological assessment of gold-bearing ores (Лодейщиков В. В. К методике технологической оценки золотосодержащих руд // Науч.тр. / Иргиредмет.- М., 1975.- Вып.29.- С.21-31.)
aliases: Лодейщиков В. В. К методике технологической оценки золотосодержащих руд // Науч.тр. / Иргиредмет.- М., 1975.- Вып.29.- С.21-31.

nodes.name: Badalov (1972) On the Causes of Gold Concentrations in Sulfide Minerals
nodes.definition: A study investigating the mechanisms leading to gold enrichment in sulfide minerals, providing a geochemical and mineralogical basis for understanding refractory gold behavior in pyrite and arsenopyrite.
nodes.text: Badalov (1972) On the Causes of Gold Concentrations in Sulfide Minerals (Бадалов С.Т. О причинах возникновения концентраций золота в сульфидных минералах // Узб.геол.журн. – 1972. – № 2.)
aliases: Бадалов С.Т. О причинах возникновения концентраций золота в сульфидных минералах // Узб.геол.журн. – 1972. – № 2.

nodes.name: Petrovskaya (1973) Native Gold
nodes.definition: A comprehensive monograph on the mineralogy, geochemistry, and processing characteristics of native gold, including its morphology, composition, and association with sulfide minerals.
nodes.text: Petrovskaya (1973) Native Gold (Петровская Н.В. Самородное золото. – М.: Наука, 1973. – 348 с.)
aliases: Петровская Н.В. Самородное золото. – М.: Наука, 1973. – 348 с.

nodes.name: Zvyagintsev (1941) Geochemistry of Gold
nodes.definition: A foundational work on the geochemical distribution and behavior of gold in the Earth's crust, covering its occurrence, migration, and concentration processes.

nodes.name: Carbonaceous Arsenopyrite Concentrate
nodes.definition: A refractory gold-bearing concentrate containing arsenopyrite (FeAsS), carbonaceous matter, and pyrite, with high organic carbon content that causes preg-robbing during cyanidation. It requires combined pretreatment (roasting, pressure leaching, or mechanochemical activation) to liberate gold.
nodes.text: Carbonaceous Arsenopyrite Concentrate (углистый арсенопирит, углистый арсенопиритный концентрат)

nodes.name: Gold-Antimony Concentrate
nodes.definition: A flotation concentrate containing both gold and antimony sulfides (mainly stibnite), which is refractory to direct cyanidation and often requires oxidative roasting or hot sodium sulfide leaching to liberate gold.
nodes.text: Gold-Antimony Concentrate (золото-сурьмяный концентрат, gold-antimony flotation concentrate)

nodes.name: Thiobacillus ferrooxidans
nodes.definition: Iron- and sulfur-oxidizing bacterium used as a bioleaching agent in sulfide concentrate processing. It accelerates oxidation of sulfides, ferrous iron, and elemental sulfur, enabling low-temperature hydrometallurgical opening of refractory gold feeds.
nodes.text: Thiobacillus ferrooxidans (Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans, T. ferrooxidans, тиобациллы железоокисляющие, тионовые железобактерии)

nodes.name: Auriferous Pyrite
nodes.definition: Pyrite containing dispersed gold inclusions or gold-bearing surface phases. In the slice, auriferous pyrite is important because flotation after cyanidation can recover gold associated with this sulfide mineral.
nodes.text: Auriferous Pyrite (золотосодержащий пирит, gold-bearing pyrite)

nodes.name: Biohydrometallurgical Technology
nodes.definition: A processing technology that uses microorganisms for the extraction of gold and silver from refractory ores, cited as a major research direction of the Irgiredmet institute.
nodes.text: Biohydrometallurgical Technology (биогидрометаллургическая технология)

nodes.name: Biooxidation
nodes.definition: A pretreatment step in which sulfide minerals in refractory gold ores or concentrates are oxidized by microorganisms to expose gold surfaces for cyanide leaching.
nodes.text: Biooxidation (bacterial oxidation, biological oxidation)

nodes.name: Sorption
nodes.definition: Uptake of dissolved substances by a solid or liquid phase through adsorption and/or absorption. In the slice, sorption is the umbrella process behind ion-exchange resin and activated-carbon recovery of precious metals from cyanide solutions.
nodes.text: Sorption (сорбция, поглощение)

nodes.name: Pyrite Biodepression
nodes.definition: The selective inhibition of pyrite flotation by using thiophilic bacteria that preferentially adhere to pyrite surfaces, rendering them hydrophilic and thereby depressing their floatability while allowing coal or other valuables to float. This technique is used in coal desulfurization and sulfide separation.
nodes.text: Pyrite Biodepression (bacterial depression of pyrite, microbial pyrite depression, thiophilic bacteria for pyrite depression)

nodes.name: Mineralogical-Petrographic Composition
nodes.definition: The mineralogical and petrographic makeup of a coal or ore feed, including the relative proportions of mineral matter and petrographic constituents. In the slice, it is a key factor controlling flotation behavior together with surface oxidation and gangue inclusion characteristics.
nodes.text: Mineralogical-Petrographic Composition (минералого-петрографический состав)

nodes.name: Wastewater Treatment
nodes.definition: Industrial and municipal treatment domain focused on removing suspended solids, microorganisms, and dissolved contaminants from effluents. Flotation is used there as a clarification and separation method.
nodes.text: Wastewater Treatment (очистка сточных вод, очистка промышленных и бытовых стоков)

nodes.name: BIOX Process
nodes.definition: A patented biooxidation process for pretreatment of refractory gold concentrates, using a consortium of bacteria (including Acidithiobacillus ferrooxidans, Leptospirillum ferrooxidans, etc.) to oxidize sulfide minerals in stirred tanks under controlled conditions. Widely applied at plants such as Ashanti Goldfields (Ghana), Harbour Lights (Australia), and others.
nodes.text: BIOX Process (BIOX bacterial oxidation, BIOX biooxidation process, Ashanti BIOX)

nodes.name: Biometallurgical Treatment
nodes.definition: A combined biological and metallurgical process used to treat refractory carbonaceous gold ores, involving microbial oxidation of sulfides and carbonaceous matter before cyanidation.
nodes.text: Biometallurgical Treatment (biomineral processing)

nodes.name: Arsenopyrite Oxidation During Roasting
nodes.definition: The chemical reaction of arsenopyrite (FeAsS) with oxygen at elevated temperature, producing iron oxides, sulfur dioxide, and volatile arsenic trioxide. This process is essential for liberating gold from the arsenopyrite lattice and reducing cyanicide content.
nodes.text: Arsenopyrite Oxidation During Roasting (окисление арсенопирита при обжиге, FeAsS oxidation)

nodes.name: Refractory Gold Ore Processing with Roasting
nodes.definition: The industrial application of oxidative roasting followed by cyanidation to treat gold ores or concentrates where gold is locked in sulfides (pyrite, arsenopyrite) or carbonaceous matter and is not amenable to direct cyanidation. The Dickenson, Giant Yellowknife, and Arthur White plants are examples.
nodes.text: Refractory Gold Ore Processing with Roasting (переработка упорных золотых руд с обжигом, roasting metallurgy for refractory gold)
aliases: переработка упорных золотых руд с обжигом

nodes.name: Mechanochemical Activation
nodes.definition: A pretreatment method in which intensive grinding in a vibration mill amorphizes the crystal structure of arsenopyrite (60–80% amorphization), reducing subsequent roasting temperature and improving gold liberation. The activation lowers the required roasting temperature from 800 °C to about 500 °C.
nodes.text: Mechanochemical Activation (механохимическая активация, механическая активация)

nodes.name: Chloride Volatilization
nodes.definition: A high-temperature chlorination process in which gold-bearing material is mixed with sodium chloride or calcium chloride and roasted in an oxidizing atmosphere so that gold is converted into volatile chlorides. The process is used to transfer gold, silver, and base metals into the gas phase for subsequent capture from flue gases.
nodes.text: Chloride Volatilization (хлоридовозгонка, хлоридная возгонка)

nodes.name: Patent 4353740 USA: Method for Gold Extraction by Chlorination
nodes.definition: Патент США, описывающий способ извлечения золота из руд и концентратов путем хлорирования (хлоридовозгонки) с последующим улавливанием летучих хлоридов золота.
nodes.text: Patent 4353740 USA: Method for Gold Extraction by Chlorination (Пат. 4353740 США, Method for extracting gold by chlorination)
aliases: Method for extracting gold by chlorination

nodes.name: Red Dome Heap Leach (Australia)
nodes.definition: Промышленное австралийское предприятие кучного выщелачивания, на котором отработана технология селективной сорбции золота на активированном угле из медьсодержащих растворов (1 мг/л Au, 1500 мг/л Cu, 500 мг/л свободного NaCN). Используется предварительное элюирование меди холодным цианистым раствором.
nodes.text: Red Dome Heap Leach (Australia) (предприятие кучного выщелачивания Ред Доум, Red Dome mine heap leach)

nodes.name: Lodeyshchikov and Panchenko 1971 Technological Assessment of Gold Solvents
nodes.definition: Paper assessing various gold solvents for industrial application, published in the collection 'Beneficiation of Ores and Sands of Noble Metals', Moscow, 1971.
nodes.text: Lodeyshchikov and Panchenko 1971 Technological Assessment of Gold Solvents (Лодейщиков В.В., Панченко А.Ф. Технологическая оценка некоторых растворителей золота)

nodes.name: Panchenko A.F. Dissertation 1972
nodes.definition: PhD dissertation (Candidate of Technical Sciences) on the technological properties of gold solvents, including thiourea, and their industrial applicability. Defended in Novosibirsk in 1972.
nodes.text: Panchenko A.F. Dissertation 1972 (Панченко А.Ф. Исследование технологических свойств некоторых растворителей рудного золота и оценка перспектив использования их в промышленной практике, Panchenko PhD thesis 1972)
aliases: Панченко А.Ф. Исследование технологических свойств некоторых растворителей рудного золота и оценка перспектив использования их в промышленной практике

nodes.name: Lodeyshchikov et al. 1975 Kinetics of Silver Dissolution in Thiourea Solutions
nodes.definition: Paper on the kinetics of silver dissolution in aqueous thiourea solutions, published in Izvestiya Vuzov, Tsvetnaya Metallurgiya, 1975.
nodes.text: Lodeyshchikov et al. 1975 Kinetics of Silver Dissolution in Thiourea Solutions (Исследование кинетики растворения серебра в водных растворах тиомочевины / В.В. Лодейщиков, Л.А. Шамис, И.А. Каковский, О.Д. Хмельницкая)
